seed_ledger.name: EdgeConneX New Albany North power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: no source ties a pipe to this 578 MW GOGPT entry. Cleanview names National Gas and Oil Cooperative as gas supplier for the smaller PowerConneX plants. The only new pipe reported is the 24-mile 24-inch line for the 430 MW PowerConneX III (existing row P8320), per Farm and Dairy. No source found for a 578 MW EdgeConneX plant by that name; the three known plants total 120 + 216 + 430 MW, so this entry may be a GOGPT grouping of PowerConneX II and III, in which case P8320 is its supply line. Searches run: 7. EdgeConneX project pages and May 2026 notice letter (no pipeline named); OPSB case coverage 25-90, 25-302, 26-361 in news (no gas lateral detail); Farm and Dairy (24-mile line for PCX III); Cleanview (supplier named, no new pipe); DCD and Power Engineering (plant specs only); city of New Albany page (no pipeline); FERC and EIA not matched by name.

evidence.note: Farm and Dairy: PowerConneX III would need a new 24-mile, 24-inch gas pipeline
